findings.message: Package, plugin, and project manifest semantic versions remain synchronized at 2.12.0-preview.3.
Both pinned trees contain zero tracked dist files; build/release specifications do not prove the candidate output digest.
The accessible installed skill cache disagrees with all three overlapping candidate Copilot skill entries.
The installed binary version matches but lacks source/build identity that can be tied to the pinned candidate.
Candidate adds one gating enforcer to the existing wiring manifest and a passing 84-occurrence ownership census.

limitations: No candidate build or package installation was executed.
No GitHub release asset/checksum was downloaded.
Safe user-level inspection was limited to known local executable, skill-cache, and plugin-cache paths; contents and secrets were not read.
